g.text: The target is arm-graded: CONTROL loses bone, EXERCISE maintains

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: What this shows: The hip BMD change target is structured by arm assignment — CONTROL mean is -0.013 (10/11 lost bone), EXERCISE mean is -0.001 (7/19 lost). The model could detect arm membership from fitness features and exploit this structure.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555

g.text: What it does not show: Whether the TFM actually exploited arm membership (Reading B) or found individual physiology (Reading A). The arm difference does not clear p<0.05, but it does not need to — the model sees individual-level features, not arm labels.

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'Arimo', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #555555
